inputFields.definition: Your sample identifier. (If no `fastaIds` column is provided, this sample ID will be used to associate the metadata with the sequence.)
inputFields.name: id

inputFields.example: EVE Group, MPI Department, Swiss TPH, Basel, Switzerland; Anderson Group, IEB Department, School of Biology, University of Edinburgh, Edinburgh, Scotland
inputFields.guidance: If multiple affiliations exist, create a semi-colon separated list in the same order as authors with one entry per author.
inputFields.name: authorAffiliations

inputFields.definition: List of authors who should be listed on the sample.
inputFields.example: Smith, Anna; Perez, Tom J.; Xu,;
inputFields.guidance: Authors should be separated by semi-colons. Each author's name should be in the format `last name, first name;`. Last name(s) is mandatory, only ASCII alphabetical characters A-Z are allowed.
inputFields.name: authors

inputFields.definition: A local administrative region from which the sample was collected (ex: Province, State, Canton).
inputFields.name: geoLocAdmin1

inputFields.definition: The country from which the sample was collected.
inputFields.guidance: Please choose a country or ocean/sea from the list of options defined by INSDC standards.
inputFields.name: geoLocCountry

options.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
The former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia

inputFields.definition: The date on which the sample was collected.
inputFields.guidance: Please format the date as `YYYY-MM-DD`. If day is unknown, use `YYYY-MM` (e.g., `2020-03`). If both day and month are unknown, use `YYYY` (e.g., `2020`). If only a range is known please supply the range in ISO format `date_lower/date_upper` where `date_lower` and `date_upper` are in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM` or `YYYY`. Please provide at least a year.
inputFields.name: sampleCollectionDate

inputFields.definition: A de-identified ID for the sample the sequence was obtained from.
inputFields.name: specimenCollectorSampleId
